headline: Liberty Form Historic Frontcourt: New York Acquires All-WNBA Forward Satou Sabally

analysis.summary: A blockbuster acquisition altering the title landscape: New York pairs Satou Sabally with Breanna Stewart and Jonquel Jones to build the most versatile, high-IQ frontcourt in WNBA history.
analysis.offensive_impact: Provides secondary ball-handling, transition playmaking (4.4 APG), and elite pick-and-pop spacing (36.1% 3PT) alongside Sabrina Ionescu.
analysis.defensive_impact: Switchability across 1 through 4 positions; elite wingspan swallows passing lanes and secures defensive boards (8.1 RPG).
analysis.risk_factor: Managing frontcourt usage balance alongside reigning MVP Breanna Stewart and Finals MVP Jonquel Jones.

headline: Former MVP Nneka Ogwumike Signs with Storm to Headline Pacific Northwest Renaissance

analysis.summary: Seattle pairs former MVP and WPA leader Nneka Ogwumike with Skylar Diggins-Smith and Jewell Loyd, transforming the Storm immediately into a title-contending juggernaut in the Western Conference.
analysis.offensive_impact: Automatic mid-range pull-up touch (49.2%) and surgical short-roll finishing; perfectly complements Loyd's perimeter gravity.
analysis.defensive_impact: Veteran defensive quarterbacking; elite positioning deterring rim attempts and commanding defensive rebound rates (22.4% DRB%).
analysis.risk_factor: Minutes load management in back-to-back schedule clusters across the 44-game campaign.

headline: Skylar Diggins-Smith Commands Seattle Backcourt Orchestration

analysis.summary: Six-time All-WNBA floor general returns to peak command, providing elite pick-and-roll orchestration and clutch perimeter execution.
analysis.offensive_impact: Premier floor spacing and drive-and-kick playmaking (6.4 APG); creates lethal transition push alongside Jewell Loyd.
analysis.defensive_impact: Aggressive point-of-attack ball harassment; forces 1.6 steals per game to trigger Seattle's high-octane break.
analysis.risk_factor: Backcourt size matchups against jumbo perimeter initiators.

headline: Mercury Acquire Defensive Tenacity and Playmaking in Natasha Cloud Trade

analysis.summary: Phoenix solves its perimeter point-of-attack defense and playmaking vacancies, placing Cloud alongside Kahleah Copper and Brittney Griner.
analysis.offensive_impact: Relieves primary ball-handling pressure from Copper; excels as high-pace distributor finding Griner on seals.
analysis.defensive_impact: All-Defensive caliber perimeter hound; elite screen navigation and ball pressure.
analysis.risk_factor: Streaky outside perimeter shooting in half-court playoff execution.

headline: Golden State Valkyries Anchor Inaugural Roster with All-Star Sharpshooter Kayla McBride

analysis.summary: The Bay Area expansion franchise lands an elite perimeter sniper (40.7% 3PT) and veteran championship culture-setter as the Valkyries' inaugural face.
analysis.offensive_impact: Gravity-bending off-ball movement; lethal coming off pin-downs and stagger screens.
analysis.defensive_impact: Disciplined team defender with strong positioning and charge-drawing instincts.
analysis.risk_factor: Heavier defensive assignment workload without established secondary rim protection.

headline: Canadian Icon Kia Nurse Returns Home as Flagship Star for Toronto Tempo

analysis.summary: A landmark cultural and sporting moment: Canadian national team star Kia Nurse headlines Toronto Tempo's historic inaugural WNBA season.
analysis.offensive_impact: Aggressive catch-and-shoot 3PT threat and perimeter floor spacing.
analysis.defensive_impact: High-energy perimeter resistance with international championship experience.
analysis.risk_factor: Establishing cohesion across an entirely brand-new expansion roster.

headline: Portland Fire Ignite Paint Foundation with Relentless Rebounder Monique Billings

analysis.summary: Portland Fire anchor their expansion frontcourt with one of the league's fiercest offensive rebounders and high-motor interior defenders.
analysis.offensive_impact: High-efficiency putbacks, rim running in transition, and screen-and-roll rolls.
analysis.defensive_impact: Physical post defender capable of battling elite interior scorers.
analysis.risk_factor: Limited shooting range outside 12 feet restricts paint spacing.

headline: Fever Secure Core Pillar: Aliyah Boston Inks 3-Year Max Extension in Indiana

analysis.summary: Indiana locks down their 2023 Rookie of the Year and franchise cornerstone alongside Caitlin Clark, ensuring the Clark-Boston two-woman engine anchors the Fever through 2029.
analysis.offensive_impact: Surgical pick-and-roll partner for Caitlin Clark; elite post footwork and interior passing.
analysis.defensive_impact: Anchor of Indiana's interior defense with disciplined verticality and defensive rebounding.
analysis.risk_factor: Defensive mobility when pulled into deep perimeter switches against 5-out offenses.
